items.title: Isaiah Morgan Interview, 1958-12-01
items.q: Well, Sonny was on the other side of the river.

ctx.x: No, he wasn't. No, he wasn't. He was gone by then. He was up here. He was one of these cats always, uh, play. I think we was playing with the Eureka, playing snare drum. No, he wasn't in those bands down there.
Was Sonny Henry down there then?
Well, Sonny was on the other side of the river. Oh, I see.
